newsitem.title: UK: UK wheat futures lower following U.S. crop data.
newsitem.headline: UK wheat futures lower following U.S. crop data.

text.p: UK wheat futures closed lower on Wednesday as the rally based on shipper short covering ran into bearish sentiment following the latest USDA crop report.
Wheat gained around 0.10 to 0.40 stg a tonne during Wednesday morning on shipper covering.
"The talk is that there are a couple of 25,000 tonners being loaded with wheat for Italy and shippers were said to be covering on the futures market," said a trader.
However, after the U.S. markets opened lower on the back of a bearish USDA crop report UK prices turned easier to end with wheat 0.15 stg to 0.35 stg down on a turnover of 657 lots.
Barley was mixed at 0.05 stg up to 0.35 stg down after trading 55 lots.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures closed one mark down after trading two lots in April at 284 marks.
On the UK coaster market Oct/Dec feed wheat fetched 109 stg a tonne fob ex-east coast.
Delivered trades were mainly small loads changing hands on a quiet market.
